verdict.summary: The change is documentation-only and accurately records why the proposed PR-time workflow-dispatch probe is unsafe and incomplete. The workflow comment preserves least privilege (`contents: read`) and does not alter execution. The design record distinguishes tree-verifiable evidence from platform claims requiring live confirmation, identifies production side effects, fork/permission and default-branch limitations, ambiguous outcomes, and the residual monitoring gap without claiming that the existing detectors close it. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
